items.description: Painting disturbed wall area and closing wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening and refinishing the affected wall area are covered under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected area under 7.1.5. The price is a moderate estimate for a small patch.
Under 7.1.7(f) the first travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Price taken from the prior (~81).
Consumable installation material is covered under 7.1.7(c). This is a small amount.
Replacement pipe section for the failed cold water line is covered under 7.1.7(c).
Insulation that formed part of the installation is covered under 7.1.7(c).
Trade labour at customary rates is covered under 7.1.7(g).
The contractor's own diagnostic or measuring devices are excluded as business outlay under 7.1.8(b).
Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). Price taken from the prior for 9 hours.
Under 7.1.7(f) only the first travel charge per contractor per invoice is paid, so this second charge is excluded.
Necessary drying before repair, with the flat-rate equipment deployment indemnified once, under 7.1.7(b) and (e).
The contractor's own blades are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Fittings needed for the pipe repair are covered under 7.1.7(c).
This is the same item invoiced twice for the same event. Only the first charge is paid under 7.1.8(c).
This appears to duplicate the insulation already billed in line 5 for the same 1 m section. That makes it likely excluded under 7.1.8(c) or (d).
This repeats line 8 for a small repair. It is likely a duplicate cost under 7.1.8(c) and beyond reasonably required time under 7.1.7(g).
